notes:
Founder's discovery call notes:
- Intro: Maya Chen (founder/CEO), early-stage consumer app for creative writing aids. 8 people, NYC.
- Wants quick self-serve onboarding; prefers hosted API for speed to market.
- Primary MVP: in-app chat assistant + short-form summary generator for user-submitted prompts. Expect ~500 DAU at launch, peak concurrency ~30-50 reqs/min.
- Latency target: 95p < 500ms, 99p under 800ms acceptable for MVP. More sensitive to per-token cost than absolute latency.
- Pricing: founder repeatedly compares to OpenAI and Anthropic - wants a straightforward per-1k-token price and example bill for 500 DAU scenario. Quote: "OpenAI credits got us confused — need predictable monthly estimate, not surprises."
- Model preference: open/compat models ok; wants Redwood catalog recommendation for cost/perf (small-medium LLM), fallback routing if capacity constrained.
- Security: SOC2 preferred, SSO for internal admin, audit logs nice-to-have but not blocking. No need for VPC/private today.
- Commercial: price-sensitive, likely annual commitment only if unit economics look favorable; otherwise self-serve pay-as-you-go.
- Action items from call: Jordan to email pricing comp sheet + sample invoice, include token burn examples for support flows and summaries. Rina to prep suggested model list + latency profile.
- Founder asks: trial credits? easy way to simulate costs before committing? Also wants to know rate limit defaults, burst policy, and per-request size limits.
- Quote from Maya: "If Redwood can show clear cost math and a simple onboarding path, we're ready to try a POC this month."
- Internal notes: competitive risk w/ Anthropic if Anthropic offers lower per-token ops; highlight Redwood's per-route controls and transparent cost tooling.
